title: 25.5 A 99.5mW/Port DC-to-40GHz Integrated Channel Analyzer for High-Density Signal Integrity Measurement in 28nm CMOS
problem: High-speed electrical links (PCB traces, coaxial cables) in dense Ethernet switches and high-performance computers suffer from reflection, crosstalk, and insertion loss; traditional VNAs and sampling oscilloscopes are power-hungry, expensive, and inefficient.
motivation: Dense channel environments in modern data-center networks require low-power, integrated signal-integrity (SI) measurement to detect link defects without expensive external test equipment.
method: Integrated channel analyzer (ICA) ASIC in 28nm CMOS using time-domain reflectometry (TDR) and time-domain transmission (TDT) techniques for SI measurements. 4-port prototype achieves DC-to-40GHz frequency range with 9.1ps rise time and only 99.5mW per port (398mW total).
key_novelty: Integrated multi-port channel analyzer ASIC achieving wide bandwidth (DC-40GHz) with low power (99.5mW/port).
contributions: 9.1ps rise time for fine temporal resolution
primary_theme: On-chip signal-integrity measurement for high-speed links
